theorems.name: Submission.iwl_imc_quotient_rescale_tendsto_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (F : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => F ρ / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ k)⁻¹) * F (R * r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
